## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, and selectable starting weapon/path.
- Implement ability evolution, RPG progression, real-time combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented ability generation, player/map setup, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD, local-storage save/load, and system tabs in `src/main.js`.
- Inspected UI selectors, art registry APIs, procedural prop/tile assets, and ability skill kinds.

### Active
- Finish `src/main.js` with world rendering, game loop, combat, movement, skills, drops, progression, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect and verify title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions; implement dungeon/boss/loot progression.
- Run syntax checks and desktop/mobile browser tests, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue `src/main.js` after `renderSystem(tab)` with rendering, gameplay loop, combat, input, and touch controls.
2. Complete progression, loot, dungeon/boss transitions, and persistence edge cases.
3. Run syntax checks and desktop/mobile browser tests; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Active game entry point; substantial setup and system UI exists, but core gameplay is unfinished.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI IDs used by the entry point, including touch controls and system tabs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities, random selection, canvas helpers, and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and exported drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and tile IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` currently ends after `renderSystem(tab)`; the animation/render loop and gameplay/input handlers are still to be implemented.
- An attempt to append rendering code failed because the exact `oldString` was not found; no code was added by that attempted edit.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, `getMonsterFrame()`, `buildHeroSprites()`, and `drawPreview()`.
- Tile values are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- Ability records use varied skill kinds; mechanics should accommodate their shared fields.
- `art.props` has asset keys such as `tree`, `rock`, `grave`, `pillar`, `crystal`, `cave`, `portal`, `house`, and `lamp`; map generation also references names like `elder`, `merchant`, `gate`, and `fence`.
- No tests or browser verification have been run; changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, and selectable starting weapon/path.
- Implement ability evolution, RPG progression, real-time combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented ability generation, player/map setup, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD, local-storage save/load, and system tabs in `src/main.js`.
- Inspected UI selectors, art registry APIs, procedural prop/tile assets, and ability skill kinds.

### Active
- Finish `src/main.js` after `renderSystem(tab)` with rendering, gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, drops, progression, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect and verify title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions; implement dungeon/boss/loot progression.
- Run syntax checks and desktop/mobile browser tests, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue `src/main.js` after `renderSystem(tab)` with rendering, gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, and input handling.
2. Complete progression, loot, dungeon/boss transitions, and persistence edge cases.
3. Run syntax checks and desktop/mobile browser tests; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Active game entry point; substantial setup and system UI exists, but core gameplay is unfinished.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI IDs used by the entry point, including touch controls and system tabs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities, random selection, canvas helpers, and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and exported drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and tile IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` currently ends after `renderSystem(tab)`; the animation/render loop and gameplay/input handlers are still to be implemented.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- `art.props` has keys such as `tree`, `rock`, `grave`, `pillar`, `crystal`, `cave`, `portal`, `house`, and `lamp`; map generation also references names like `elder`, `merchant`, `gate`, and `fence`.
- Ability records use varied skill kinds; mechanics should accommodate their shared fields.
- `getMonsterFrame(type, frame)` selects from monster or boss sprite sets; hero sprites are organized by `down`, `up`, and `side` directions.
- No tests or browser verification have been run; changes are uncommitted.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, and selectable starting weapon/path.
- Implement ability evolution, RPG progression, real-time combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` has setup for abilities, player/map creation, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD, local-storage save/load, and system tabs.

### Active
- Finish `src/main.js` after `renderSystem(tab)` with rendering, gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, drops, progression, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions; implement dungeon/boss/loot progression.
- Run syntax checks and desktop/mobile browser tests, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue `src/main.js` after `renderSystem(tab)` with rendering, gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, and input handling.
2. Complete progression, loot, dungeon/boss transitions, and persistence edge cases.
3. Run syntax checks and desktop/mobile browser tests; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Active game entry point; substantial setup and system UI exists, but core gameplay is unfinished.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI IDs, including touch controls and system tabs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities, random selection, canvas helpers, and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and exported drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and tile IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` currently ends after `renderSystem(tab)`; the animation/render loop and gameplay/input handlers are still to be implemented.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- `art.props` includes keys such as `tree`, `rock`, `grave`, `pillar`, `crystal`, `cave`, `portal`, `house`, and `lamp`; map generation also references names like `elder`, `merchant`, and `gate`.
- Ability records use varied skill kinds; mechanics should accommodate their shared fields.
- `getMonsterFrame(type, frame)` selects from monster or boss sprite sets; hero sprites are organized by `down`, `up`, and `side` directions.
- No tests or browser verification have been run; changes are uncommitted.
- A render implementation was drafted but not applied: attempts to append it with `edit` failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js. It must match exactly, including whitespace and indentation.`

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, and selectable starting weapon/path.
- Implement ability evolution, RPG progression, real-time combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` contains setup for abilities, player/map creation, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD, local-storage save/load, system tabs, and newly appended world drawing helpers.

### Active
- Finish `src/main.js` with gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, drops, progression, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions; implement dungeon/boss/loot progression.
- Run syntax checks and desktop/mobile browser tests, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/main.js` and correct any syntax issues in the newly appended drawing code.
2. Implement the gameplay loop, combat, input handling, progression, loot, and dungeon/boss transitions.
3. Run syntax checks and desktop/mobile browser tests; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Active game entry point; gameplay and input implementation remains unfinished.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI IDs, including touch controls and system tabs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities, random selection, canvas helpers, and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and exported drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and tile IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- The previous `edit` attempts to append drawing functions failed because exact text matching did not succeed; the latest attempt appended code using `cat >> src/main.js`.
- Newly appended code defines tile selection and drawing helpers (`tileImage`, `tileFor`, `drawWorld`, entity/prop/projectile/effect/drop/weather/lighting/minimap renderers). No syntax or runtime checks have been run.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- `art.props` has no `gate` or NPC keys as prop images; `drawProp` falls back to rock for non-NPC types without a matching prop.
- Work is uncommitted.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, and selectable starting weapon/path.
- Implement ability evolution, RPG progression, real-time combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` has setup for abilities, player/map creation, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD, local-storage save/load, system tabs, and world drawing helpers.
- Appended tile selection and renderers for the world, entities, props, projectiles, effects, drops, weather, lighting, and minimap.

### Active
- Implement the gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, drops, progression, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions; implement dungeon/boss/loot progression.
- Check syntax and run desktop/mobile browser tests; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/main.js` and run a syntax check on the newly appended drawing code.
2. Implement the gameplay loop, combat, controls, progression, and dungeon/boss/loot transitions.
3. Run desktop and mobile browser tests, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Active game entry point; gameplay and input implementation remains unfinished.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI IDs, including touch controls and system tabs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities, random selection, canvas helpers, and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and exported drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and tile IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- Recent `edit` attempts to append drawing functions failed because the exact text did not match; the latest append to `src/main.js` using `cat >>` succeeded.
- Drawing helpers reference game state such as `mapSeed`, `mapType`, `camera`, `props`, `monsters`, `player`, and `time`; verify these symbols and their expected shapes before runtime testing.
- `art.props` has no `gate` or NPC keys as prop images; `drawProp` falls back to rock for non-NPC types without a matching prop.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- Changes are uncommitted; no syntax or runtime tests have been run.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, and selectable starting weapon/path.
- Implement ability evolution, RPG progression, real-time combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` contains character/ability setup, map and player creation, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD/system panels, save/load, and world/entity drawing helpers.
- Added renderers for world tiles, entities, props, projectiles, effects, drops, weather, lighting, and minimap.
- `node --check src/main.js` passed at the checkpoint, before the latest drawing-code append.

### Active
- Implement gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, loot, progression, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions; implement dungeon/boss/loot progression.
- Test syntax and desktop/mobile browser behavior; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and syntax-check the current `src/main.js`; the prior check predates its appended drawing helpers.
2. Implement the game loop, combat, controls, progression, and dungeon/boss/loot transitions.
3. Run desktop and mobile browser tests, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Active game entry point; gameplay and input implementation remains unfinished.
- `index.html`: Screens, HUD, system tabs, and touch-control IDs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities, random selection, canvas helpers, and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and exported drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and tile IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed the project files as untracked.
- `src/main.js` is only 76 physical lines due to heavily compressed one-line functions; the appended renderer helpers were present in its latest read.
- Drawing helpers depend on state including `mapSeed`, `mapType`, `camera`, `props`, `monsters`, `player`, and `time`.
- `art.props` has no `gate` or NPC keys as prop images; `drawProp` falls back to rock for non-NPC types without a matching prop.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, selectable starting weapon/path, ability evolution, RPG progression, combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` contains character/ability setup, map and player creation, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD/system panels, save/load, rendering helpers, and world/entity drawing.
- `node --check src/main.js` passed before the latest renderer append; gameplay code has not been applied.

### Active
- Implement and validate gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, loot, progression, dungeon/boss transitions, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions.
- Test desktop and mobile behavior; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

### Blocked
- A large gameplay edit failed because its exact `drawMinimap` anchor did not match; no gameplay code from that edit was applied.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/main.js` and append or apply gameplay code using the exact current file contents as the anchor.
2. Run `node --check src/main.js` and fix syntax/runtime issues, including matching HTML IDs and ability skill kinds.
3. Test the game in desktop and mobile browsers, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Main game entry point; gameplay/input wiring remains unfinished.
- `index.html`: Screens, HUD, system tabs, and touch-control IDs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities, random selection, and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and tile IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted; project files were previously shown as untracked.
- `src/main.js` is heavily compressed into 76 physical lines; most existing functions occupy one line.
- Last failed edit returned `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`; gameplay additions were not applied.
- Rendering helpers depend on `mapSeed`, `mapType`, `camera`, `props`, `monsters`, `player`, and `time`.
- `art.props` has no `gate` or NPC keys as prop images; `drawProp` falls back to rock for non-NPC types without a matching prop.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- HTML cooldown IDs are `cd-0`, `cd-1`, and `cd-2`; avoid assuming they use another naming pattern.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, selectable starting weapon/path, ability evolution, RPG progression, combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` has character/ability setup, map and player creation, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD/system panels, save/load, rendering helpers, and world/entity drawing.

### Active
- Implement and validate gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, loot, progression, dungeon/boss transitions, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions.
- Test desktop and mobile behavior; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

### Blocked
- Gameplay code remains unapplied; the previous large edit failed because its exact `drawMinimap` anchor did not match.

## Next Move
1. Append gameplay code to `src/main.js` using its current exact contents.
2. Run `node --check src/main.js`; check runtime behavior and match HTML IDs and ability skill kinds.
3. Test in desktop and mobile browsers, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Main entry point; gameplay and input wiring are unfinished.
- `index.html`: Screens, HUD, system tabs, and touch-control IDs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- `src/main.js` is heavily compressed into 76 physical lines; most functions occupy one line.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- `drawProp` falls back to rock for non-NPC types without a matching prop image; `art.props` has no gate or NPC images.
- HTML cooldown IDs are `cd-0`, `cd-1`, and `cd-2`.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, selectable starting weapon/path, ability evolution, RPG progression, combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` has character/ability setup, map and player creation, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD/system panels, save/load, rendering helpers, and world/entity drawing.
- Current `src/main.js` contents and relevant HTML IDs and ability skill kinds have been inspected.

### Active
- Implement gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, loot, progression, dungeon/boss transitions, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions.
- Test desktop and mobile behavior; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Append gameplay and input code to `src/main.js` after its current `drawMinimap` function.
2. Run `node --check src/main.js`; check runtime behavior and match HTML IDs and ability skill kinds.
3. Test desktop and mobile behavior, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Main entry point; gameplay and input wiring are unfinished.
- `index.html`: Screens, HUD, system tabs, and touch-control IDs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- `src/main.js` is heavily compressed into 76 physical lines; most functions occupy one line.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- `drawProp` falls back to rock for non-NPC types without a matching prop image; `art.props` has no gate or NPC images.
- HTML cooldown IDs are `cd-0`, `cd-1`, and `cd-2`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue, randomized permanent ability awakening across Common–Divine rarity, selectable starting weapon/path, ability evolution, RPG progression, combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` has character and ability setup, map and player creation, dialogue and awakening presentation, HUD/system panels, save/load, rendering helpers, and world/entity drawing.
- Inspected relevant HTML IDs and ability skill kinds.

### Active
- Implement gameplay loop, combat, movement, skills, loot, progression, dungeon/boss transitions, and keyboard/mouse/touch controls.
- Connect title, character creation, awakening, dialogue, and system interactions.
- Test desktop and mobile behavior; inspect screenshots and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Append gameplay and input code to `src/main.js` after its current `drawMinimap` function.
2. Run `node --check src/main.js`; check runtime behavior and match HTML IDs and ability skill kinds.
3. Test desktop and mobile behavior, inspect screenshots, and fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Main entry point; gameplay and input wiring are unfinished.
- `index.html`: Screens, HUD, system tabs, and touch-control IDs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and drawing helpers.
- `src/art/tiles.js`: Tile canvases and IDs.
- `src/art/heroes.js`: Hero sprites, portraits, and preview rendering.
- `src/art/monsters.js`: Monster definitions and sprite generation.
- `src/art/bosses.js`: Boss sprite definitions and generation.
- `src/art/props.js`: Procedural world props.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- `src/main.js` is heavily compressed into 76 physical lines; most functions occupy one line.
- Art APIs include `initArt()`, `art.tiles`, `art.props`, `art.monsters`, `art.bosses`, and `getMonsterFrame()`. Tiles are arrays; water and lava use nested frame arrays.
- `drawProp` falls back to rock for non-NPC types without a matching prop image; `art.props` has no gate or NPC images.
- HTML cooldown IDs are `cd-0`, `cd-1`, and `cd-2`.
- `index.html` uses `#btn-new`, `#btn-continue`, `#btn-how`, `#btn-begin`, `#btn-accept-awakening`, `#sys-close`, and `data-action`/`data-tab` controls.
- Skill kinds include `projectile`, `nova`, `buff`, `pull`, `beam`, `dash`, `slam`, `heal`, `summon`, `shield`, `drain`, `chain`, `teleport`, `blinkstrike`, and others; generic fallback handling is needed.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue and randomized permanent ability awakening, selectable starting path, ability evolution, RPG progression, combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` contains character/ability setup, map and player creation, awakening and dialogue UI, HUD/system panels, save/load, rendering, and world/entity drawing.
- Appended gameplay and input implementation to `src/main.js`: combat, skills, movement, enemy AI, loot, XP/leveling/evolution, dungeons, interactions, touch controls, UI actions, and game loop.

### Active
- Validate syntax and browser runtime; fix gameplay and UI issues found during testing.
- Test desktop and mobile controls and inspect screenshots.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check src/main.js` and resolve any syntax errors.
2. Run the game and test character creation, awakening, movement, combat, skills, progression, dungeon transitions, saving/loading, and mobile controls.
3. Inspect screenshots and fix rendering or responsive-layout issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Main implementation; recent gameplay code was appended here and remains unvalidated.
- `index.html`: Screens, HUD, system tabs, and touch-control IDs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and drawing helpers.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted.
- `src/main.js` is heavily compressed; most functions occupy one physical line.
- HTML cooldown IDs are `cd-0`, `cd-1`, and `cd-2`; key controls include `#btn-new`, `#btn-continue`, `#btn-begin`, `#btn-accept-awakening`, `#sys-close`, and `data-action`/`data-tab` controls.
- Recent implementation has not yet been syntax-checked or tested in a browser.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED**, a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Include character creation, prologue and randomized permanent ability awakening, selectable starting path, ability evolution, RPG progression, combat, varied dungeons and bosses, loot, persistence, and responsive phone/tablet controls.
- Aim for detailed pixel-art presentation with animation, lighting, weather, particles, shadows, and environmental variety.

## Decisions
- Use procedural pixel-art assets and a browser-based implementation.
- Keep starting-path selection in character creation.
- Generate Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities because no dedicated data file exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented core game systems and UI in `src/main.js`, including character and ability setup, maps, awakening and dialogue, HUD and system panels, saving/loading, rendering, combat, skills, movement, enemy AI, loot, XP/leveling/evolution, dungeons, interactions, touch controls, and game loop.
- `node --check src/main.js` passes.
- Started a local HTTP server and successfully captured a headless Chromium screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/eclipse.png`.

### Active
- Inspect the captured title-screen screenshot and validate runtime/game flow behavior.

### Blocked
- Browser interaction automation has not been performed; browser console and gameplay behaviors remain unverified.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/eclipse.png` for title-screen layout issues.
2. Test character creation, awakening, movement, combat, skills, progression, dungeon transitions, saving/loading, and mobile controls in a browser; check console errors.
3. Fix and retest any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Main implementation; gameplay and input logic is heavily compressed and not fully tested.
- `index.html`: Screens, HUD, system controls, touch-control IDs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `src/utils.js`: Shared utilities and geometry.
- `src/art/index.js`: Procedural art registry and drawing helpers.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon abilities.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic abilities.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Awakening rarity definitions and weights.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- HTML cooldown IDs are `cd-0`, `cd-1`, and `cd-2`; key controls include `#btn-new`, `#btn-continue`, `#btn-begin`, `#btn-accept-awakening`, `#sys-close`, and `data-action`/`data-tab` controls.
- Local server command was `python3 -m http.server 8765`; screenshot URL was `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
